column1: # One line per tenant: name, monthly budget in USD, the virtual key. `make local-up` applies it
# (keys.sh) and re-applies it on every start, so edit here and restart the gateway to change a
# budget. Keys are the tenant's NW_GATEWAY_KEY; rotate by editing the third column.
# Cohort mode: one line per learner. Solo mode: the `solo` line is enough.
